kol.detail: ## eval competition idea: Help kill my SaaS my team is proposing to pay >$40k/year for enterprise saas we have never used and will never be able to customize. as a smol business owner, this feels shitty. thinking of doing a small remote hackathon: - i cover $1000 in tokens for you - you do your best to clone this SaaS in a weekend - my team (your prospective customer) evals it - winner gets $10,000 cash & @latentspacepod writeup - all code is open sourced everyone wins except high margin low moat saas. we keep doing this with increasingly ambitious saas things for SMBs until we find the bounda...
kol.detail_zh: Swyx 提议举办一场黑客松，旨在通过模仿并克隆那些昂贵且无法定制的企业级 SaaS 产品，来挑战这些高毛利但缺乏护城河的软件。参赛者需在周末内完成克隆，胜者将获得 1 万美元奖金和相关报道，同时所有代码将开源。Swyx 计划通过这种方式持续挑战针对中小企业的 SaaS 市场，寻找 AI 技术对传统软件行业的颠覆边界。

kol.detail: Watching a presentation on how we're making systems ultra-resilient to 𝚞𝚜-𝚎𝚊𝚜𝚝-𝟷 outages. Team reminded me the last AWS outage shut down my IoT mattress 😂 One of the many benefits of @vercel Fluid compute is how easy multi-region failover becomes, which allows you to sleep in an ultra-cold bed soundly all night.
kol.detail_zh: Vercel 正在通过其 Fluid Compute 技术提升系统的韧性，旨在应对如 us-east-1 区域性的 AWS 停机故障。该技术的核心优势在于简化了多区域故障转移（multi-region failover）的流程，从而确保应用在基础设施发生区域性中断时仍能保持高可用性。

kol_archive.take_zh: Andrej Karpathy 通过测试 Opus 5 根据《指环王》文本生成三维渲染代码的案例，展示了大型语言模型在处理超长上下文及复杂指令方面的强大能力，同时也指出了模型在原生感知视频与游戏环境方面存在的局限性。
kol_archive.detail: We're starting to leave the territory where you'd test an LLM by e.g. "create an svg of pelican on a bicycle". As one idea to generalize it, I was interested what Opus 5 would do if I gave it the first paragraph of the Lord of the Rings, a 1M token budget (~$10) and asked for three js render of it. Opus went off for ~2 hours and wrote 5500 lines of code that (procedurally) rendered the story. It's kind of janky but fun. But it's a bit mindboggling that the LLM has to place and orchestrate various polygon assets in (x,y,z) coordinates and write code that animates it all, and that it even does a...
kol_archive.detail_zh: 随着大语言模型能力的演进，测试基准正从简单的指令转向更复杂的任务。Andrej Karpathy 分享了一个实验：在给予 100 万 token 预算的情况下，让 Claude 3 Opus 根据《指环王》的第一段内容编写 Three.js 代码。该模型耗时约 2 小时编写了 5500 行代码，通过程序化方式在三维空间内编排多边形资产并实现动画渲染，展现了模型在复杂逻辑编排与空间坐标处理上的惊人潜力。

kol_archive.detail: We built an agent that powers our company's internal operations called @𝚟. Every day-to-day job at Vercel now involves @𝚟. It's growing exponentially both in daily interactions and token use. One can extrapolate to the day AI agents run entire companies from here. It's an expert in finance, comms, docs, marketing, engineering, business analytics. It's seeded by the skills we gave it and we update, but it's also constantly improving. It already keeps memories and personalized workflows and schedules on a per-user basis. For example, I knew skills⁠.sh hit 1M skills and I shared this on these for...

kol_archive.detail_zh: Swyx 指出，尽管此前 Agent Lab 的核心论点集中在评估、路由、交互性和投资回报率（ROI）上，但 Claude Code 今年“意外”开源（指其能力及模式公开化）这一事实，并未对 Claude 或其竞争对手的产品路线图产生实质性的冲击或改变。这表明目前的模型路由与 Agent 演进逻辑在面对这类工具的冲击时表现出了极强的韧性。

kol_archive.take_en: As agents gain autonomy over code, runtimes need more determinism, isolation and recovery; faster generation raises the value of engineering constraints.
kol_archive.take_zh: Kimi 的最新研究强调了为 AI 智能体构建安全边界的重要性，实验显示仅靠容器级隔离不足以防止故障。由于智能体可能通过内核错误导致底层机器崩溃，因此采用 Firecracker 微型虚拟机是确保安全运行的有效方案。
kol_archive.detail: Kimi's paper underlines the importance of the right security boundary for agents to run in. tl:DR: container-level isolation is not enough. In their experiments, agents crashed the underlying machine (via kernel panics). Firecracker microVMs (as in Vercel Sandbox) are safe.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出 Kimi 的研究强调了为 AI Agent 构建正确安全边界的重要性。实验表明，仅靠容器级隔离（container-level isolation）不足以保证安全，Agent 甚至可能导致底层机器崩溃（kernel panics）。相比之下，使用 Firecracker 微型虚拟机（如 Vercel Sandbox 所采用的技术）才能确保运行安全性。

kol_archive.detail: Sriram Krishnan joins Theo Jaffee and Sofia Puccini just after concluding his tenure as Senior White House Policy Advisor on AI to discuss one of the biggest weeks yet for open-source AI. They unpack the rapid release of models including Kimi K3 and Qwen, why open models are putting pressure on frontier labs, and what it means for pricing, competition, and the future of AI infrastructure. They also discuss AI policy, distillation, cybersecurity, the role of open-weight models, whether the U.S. should respond to China's growing AI capabilities, and how governments and frontier labs should navig...
kol_archive.detail_zh: Sriram Krishnan 分析了开源 AI 的重大进展，重点讨论了 Kimi K3 和 Qwen 等模型的快速发布如何对前沿实验室产生压力。讨论涵盖了开源模型对定价和竞争格局的影响，以及蒸馏技术、网络安全和开源权重模型在 AI 基础设施中的作用。此外，他还探讨了 AI 政策及美国应如何应对中国日益增长的 AI 能力。

kol_archive.detail: Claude Opus 5 is now on AI Gateway with support for fast mode. Improvements versus previous Opus models on agentic coding and quality at lower reasoning effort levels. 𝚖𝚘𝚍𝚎𝚕: '𝚊𝚗𝚝𝚑𝚛𝚘𝚙𝚒𝚌/𝚌𝚕𝚊𝚞𝚍𝚎-𝚘𝚙𝚞𝚜-𝟻'
kol_archive.detail_zh: Claude Opus 5 已正式上线 AI Gateway 并支持快速模式（fast mode）。相较于此前的 Opus 模型，新版本在智能代理编码（agentic coding）及低推理成本下的生成质量方面均有显著提升，模型标识符为 'anthropic/claude-opus-5'。

kol_archive.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol_archive.take_en: Agent value is moving from one-shot generation to durable workflows; state, cost attribution, tool use and feedback loops drive token usage and stickiness.
kol_archive.take_zh: Opus 5 在编程、数据分析及生物学等高阶知识领域表现卓越。最核心的突破在于通过强化模型对齐与 Claude Code 自动模式，将其面临的提示词注入（Prompt Injection）攻击成功率降至接近 0。
kol_archive.detail: Opus 5 is a great model for coding, data analysis, design, biology, knowledge work. More than any of these eval scores, what is most exciting to me is something else: Opus 5 is our least prompt injectable model yet. It is a bit buried in the system card, but across PI evals and red teaming, Opus 5 is very hard to prompt inject successfully. And when layering defenses -- strong model alignment, combined with prompt injection probes, combined with Auto Mode in Claude Code -- the success rate for prompt injection attacks drops to ~0. This is new and exciting! More about this soon.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Opus 5 在编程、数据分析、设计及生物学等知识工作领域表现出色。其最显著的进步在于安全性大幅提升，通过强化模型对齐、提示词注入探测以及 Claude Code 中的自动模式，其提示词注入（Prompt Injection）攻击的成功率已降至接近 0。

kol_archive.detail_zh: 讨论聚焦于开源 AI 的生存危机，包括 Kimi K3 的引发的恐慌以及 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 可能存在的监管俘获现象；Anthropic 近期因 15 亿美元的版权侵权和解案引发了关于知识产权盗窃双标的争议。此外，由于 AI 资本支出激增，Google 与 Tesla 股价表现低迷，同时节目还深入探讨了中国在 AI 领域的长期战略布局。

kol_archive.take: AI 基础设施的约束正向能源侧移动；当芯片和集群继续扩张，电网容量、供电周期与单位能耗会决定新增 token 供给。
kol_archive.take_en: AI infrastructure is becoming energy-constrained; grid capacity, power lead times and energy efficiency increasingly determine new token supply.
kol_archive.take_zh: 2024至2029年间，AI与数据中心总资本支出预计达11万亿美元，其中7.1万亿美元需外部融资，且约75%将通过债务方式实现。目前，仅有具备投资级超大规模云服务商五年承购协议的项目能稳妥通过贷款审批。
kol_archive.detail: AI and datacenter CapEx hits $11 trillion cumulatively from 2024 to 2029, and $7.1 trillion of that needs funding, roughly 75% debt financed. Dan Nishball (@dnishball), Zane Fong (linkedin.com/in/zanefongzq), and Kang Wen Cheang (linkedin.com/in/cheangkangwen) sit with Jordan Nanos (@JordanNanos) to break down the AI project Trinity: capital, offtake, and data centers. Today only one deal reliably clears the lending bar, a five-year offtake from an investment-grade hyperscaler. Everything else struggles to finance. The crew explains how NVIDIA backstops are structured, how lenders price GPU lo...
kol_archive.detail_zh: 2024年至2029年间，AI与数据中心的总资本支出预计将达到11万亿美元，其中约7.1万亿美元需要外部融资，且约75%将通过债务方式解决。目前，仅有具备投资级超大规模云服务商（Hyperscaler）五年期承购协议的项目能稳妥通过贷款审批，其余项目均面临融资困境。此外，讨论还涉及了NVIDIA提供的担保结构以及贷款机构对GPU资产的定价方式。

kol_archive.take_zh: Poolside 创始人认为编程是通往通用人工智能的关键路径，该公司通过模型工厂每月进行上万次实验，能在八周内产出新模型，并主张通过 Laguna S 算法实现模型的持续验证。
kol_archive.detail: Poolside’s Race to AGI: Model Factory, Laguna S, Open Models, & Beyond MCP @poolsideai co-founder and CEO @eisokant explains why coding is the path to AGI, how Poolside’s Model Factory runs 10,000–20,000 experiments a month and turns new models around in as little as eight weeks, why Laguna S suggests persistence and verification may matter more than raw intelligence, why agents are already helping build the next generation of models, and why the future should have 100 foundation model companies not five.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Poolside CEO Maximilien Drmaç 认为编程是实现通用人工智能（AGI）的路径，其“模型工厂”模式每月进行 1-2 万次实验，仅需 8 周即可迭代出新模型。他提出 Laguna S 概念，强调持久性和验证能力比单纯追求原始智能更重要，并认为 Agent 技术正助力下一代模型的构建。此外，他预测未来的格局应由 100 家基础模型公司组成，而非仅有少数几家。

kol_archive.take: 模型能力仍受底层计算效率与供给约束；硬件、系统软件和推理优化共同决定可交付的速度与成本。
kol_archive.take_en: Model economics still depend on compute efficiency and supply; hardware, systems software and inference optimization jointly determine speed and cost.
kol_archive.take_zh: Cognition 推出 Devin Outposts，支持在 Mac mini、实验室 GPU 服务器、私有网络虚拟机或 Kubernetes 集群等任意自有基础设施上运行 Devin。
kol_archive.detail: Introducing Devin Outposts: run Devin on any machine. Your Mac mini, a GPU box in your lab, a VM inside your private network, or a Kubernetes cluster next to your internal services.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Cognition 公司推出了 Devin Outposts，旨在实现 Devin 在任何环境下的部署。用户现在可以在 Mac mini、实验室 GPU 服务器、私有网络内的虚拟机或 Kubernetes 集群中运行该 AI 软件，从而使其能直接访问内部服务并适应不同的计算架构。
